[1mDescription[22m:
Discover, start, resume, and inspect installed Workflow Packages

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli workflow[22m <command> [options]

[1mCommands[22m:
  [1mcancel <run-id>[22m           Request cancellation and observe execution drain
  [1mdescribe <workflow-name>[22m  Describe a registered Workflow
  [1mdoctor[22m                    Check Workflow Agent Host transports without running an Agent task
  [1mevents[22m                    Read or follow the public event timeline of a Workflow Run
  [1mlist[22m                      List registered built-in and optional Workflows
  [1mresult[22m                    Read terminal Results or submit an Agent-guided terminal result
  [1mresume <run-id>[22m           Resume a suspended code Workflow with an Agent Task response
  [1mrun[22m                       Inspect the authoritative lifecycle of a Workflow Run
  [1msnapshot[22m                  Inspect the latest public Snapshot published by a Workflow Run
  [1mstart <workflow-name>[22m     Start a registered Workflow
  [1mwait <run-id>[22m             Wait for a Workflow Run to reach a terminal status
  [1mweb[22m                       Open, list and close local Workflow Web viewers
  [1mweb [run-id][22m              Browse local Workflow Runs, or open a selected Run

[1mOptions[22m:
  [1m-h, --help[22m  Show this message and exit.
